result.topic_en: A faint, heavily corrected pencil draft, written on a printed postal-account form, on representing algebraic functions on a Riemann surface T: a function s' that is infinite of first order at m' points satisfies an algebraic equation F(s',z)=0, the surface has 2(m'+p-1) branch points, and a count of 3(p-1) appears, apparently for moduli.
